name: Yasutomi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yasutomi town emblem in white: a ring with four small points enclosing a stylised letter A.
history: Flag of the former town of Yasutomi in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-27. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 January 1962.

features.role: Yasutomi town emblem — a ring with four small points enclosing a stylised letter A
